site.description: Hello! I'm Dimitri Simjanoski, an 11-year-old from Tampa Bay who loves engineering, mountain biking, space and computers. Check out what I'm building, my hobbies and my friends.

person.name: Dimitri Simjanoski
person.headline: 11 years old, obsessed with engineering, and happiest on a mountain bike.
person.currently: building a skyscraper model for my engineering class

paragraphs: I'm Dimitri, I'm 11, and I'm obsessed with how things get built — bridges, skyscrapers, bikes, computers, all of it.

Right now I'm building a skyscraper model for my engineering class and learning how truss bridges work: why triangles are so strong, and how a few thin beams can hold way more weight than you'd think.
When I'm not doing that, I'm mountain biking (my real passion), playing soccer or basketball, gaming with my friends, or sleeping. Sleeping counts as a hobby.
